voice.name: JC - Deep, Thoughful and Encouraging
voice.why: Father Etienne Morel wants the day to be honest. JC is a deep, unhurried man over sixty with a French accent, who sounds like someone who has sat with people in grief: the oldest and slowest of the town's voices, which suits a priest at a memorial. Speed 0.85 and higher stability keep it steady and quiet.

memorial.text: Three years ago they walked out of the night with what they could carry. We remember each of them. Stand with us a moment.
